title: The moon phase tarot spread
description: How to use the moon phase tarot spread: eight cards for the lunar cycle, what each phase asks, and how to read it in one sitting or across a month.

scenes.headline: The moon phase tarot spread
scenes.caption: The moon phase tarot spread uses eight cards, one for each phase of the lunar cycle. The phases work as a metaphor for starting, building, seeing and releasing.
scenes.vo: The moon phase tarot spread uses eight cards, one for each phase of the lunar cycle. The phases work as a metaphor for starting, building, seeing and releasing.

scenes.headline: The eight positions
scenes.caption: New moon, waxing crescent, first quarter, waxing gibbous, then full moon.
scenes.vo: The eight positions. New moon, waxing crescent, first quarter, waxing gibbous, then full moon.

scenes.headline: Laying it in a ring
scenes.caption: Place the cards in a circle, with the new moon at the top and the rest following clockwise, like a moon calendar.
scenes.vo: Laying it in a ring. Place the cards in a circle, with the new moon at the top and the rest following clockwise, like a moon calendar.

scenes.headline: Using it in a single sitting
scenes.caption: Most people lay the full spread in one session.
scenes.vo: Using it in a single sitting. Most people lay the full spread in one session.
